easyPrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
description:
Declare Wizards of Thay as an attacker, triggering its myriad ability, creating at least two token copies of it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to each Wizards of Thay, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2
